component.name: Colophon
component.summary: A book library for book lovers
本好きのための書籍管理アプリ

description.p: Keep track of the books you own, your reading status, cover images, notes (impressions, learnings, memos, excerpts), tags, and the dates you finished each book.
蔵書の登録、読書ステータス、書影、ノート（感想・学び・メモ・抜粋）、タグ、読了日を管理できます。

ul.li: Fetch book details from an ISBN
Export and import (text, JSON + images, SQLite)
Optional sync between computers through your own Google Drive
7 display languages and 6 color themes, including a color-vision friendly theme

description.p: Sort the library by reading status, from Not set to Finished or the reverse.
Optional sync between computers through your own Google Drive, and a user guide with animated screenshots.
